newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Swedish Q3 GDP to rise 1.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Swedish Q3 GDP to rise 1.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Sweden's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) was seen rising 0.6 percent in the third quarter of 1996 compared to the previous quarter and 1.5 percent compared with the third quarter of 1995, a poll of 15 analysts showed.
The forecasts ranged from a fall of 0.6 percent to a rise of 1.5 percent for the quarter, giving year on year increases ranging from 0.4 percent to 2.25 percent.
For full-year 1996 GDP was expected to increase by 1.6 percent, the average of analysts' responses showed. Forecasts for the full-year figure spanned rises of 1.2 to 2.0 percent.

In the second quarter GDP rose 0.7 (seasonally adjusted) percent, corresponding to a year on year increase of 1.4 percent. In the third quarter of 1995 GDP rose 0.8 percent for a year rise of five percent.
Sweden's official statistics bureau Statistic Sweden is due to publish the figure on December 12 at 1200 GMT.

Sources were Carnegie, Consensus, Den Danske Bank, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, HSBC Midland, JP Morgan, Morgan Stanley, Nordbanken, PaineWebber, Salomon Brothers, S-E-Banken, Transferator, Union Bank of Switzerland, and Unibank Markets.
